summary: Shows how to decrypt an encrypted string by piping it to ansible-vault decrypt on stdin, or by running ansible-vault decrypt and pasting it, ending with Ctrl+D twice.
questions: How do I decrypt a single vault-encrypted string?
Can I paste vaulted ciphertext into ansible-vault to read it?

answer_card.title: Decrypt an encrypted string
answer_card.answer_md:
Pipe the ciphertext in:

```bash
echo -e '$ANSIBLE_VAULT;1.1;...' | ansible-vault decrypt
```

Or run `ansible-vault decrypt` with no file, paste the ciphertext, and press Ctrl+D twice to end input.
